name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian precious metals development company advancing its flagship Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026, establishing Diablillos as a fully permitted, large-scale silver-gold development project targeting first production in 2029. AbraSilver trades on the TSX as ABRA and on the OTCQX as ABBRF.
